title: Mechanistic study of structural regulation and enhanced oxygen reduction performance in La0.5Sr1.5FeO4+δ cathodes via Mg doping
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27837-27846
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03050E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanpeng Liu, Songbo Li, Shengli An, Hongli Qiao, Yuanyaun Ma, Jia Xu, Jing Zhang, Xu Zhang, Jianlin Zhao
Mg doping adjusts La0.5Sr1.5FeO4+δ lattice, raises oxygen vacancies and speeds up oxygen ion transport. Optimized LSFM0.05 cathode gains higher ORR activity, lower ASR and good thermal compatibility, boosting IT-SOFC performance and stability.
